trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for everything else: all 54 other trophies, story, collectibles, activities and the 100% completion gold. There is no shortcut and no online requirement; every trophy is single-player and offline. Plan on roughly 200 hours at a relaxed pace, and keep cheats off the whole run, since a cheat disables trophies and saving. Work the roadmap in this guide stage by stage and the platinum pops the moment the last trophy does.
steps: Finish the story across all five chapters.
Work the 100% completion checklist after the credits.
Clear the collectibles, activities and robbery trophies in the roadmap stages.
Keep cheats off and keep a manual save before any one-off moment.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, is where the story begins, and this trophy pops when you finish it. It is unmissable: just play through the opening beats, follow the on-screen prompts, and the trophy unlocks at the mission's end. Use the opening to learn the controls, the weapon wheel and the driving, because the same systems carry the whole game.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission Gone Fishing.
Follow the mission markers and complete each objective.
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 closes with this trophy. Play through the chapter's missions in order; there is no way to skip ahead, and nothing in the chapter can lock you out of the trophy. It pops on the chapter-complete screen. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing the guides flag: the balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude), the only trophy the published guides call potentially missable.
steps: Play the Chapter 1 missions in order.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation after Down to Earth, before the chapter ends.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2's completion trophy. Keep playing the story missions in order; side content can wait, since free roam stays open after the story and nearly everything can be finished later. The trophy unlocks when the chapter wraps.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 missions in order.
Take on side activities between missions if you like; none of them blocks the chapter.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3's completion trophy, unlocked the same way: finish the chapter's missions in order. By now the map is opening up, so it is a good moment to start the slow-burn counters — scanning vehicles with the WAiNK app and studying animals through binoculars — because both feed the 100% checklist later.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 missions in order.
Between missions, scan new vehicles with WAiNK and study animals with binoculars.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4's completion trophy. Same approach: story missions in order, trophy on completion. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in this chapter, so if a bank-job contact appears, take it — robbing bank vaults feeds both a silver trophy and the 100% checklist.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 missions in order.
Accept the optional mission that opens bank jobs when it appears.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The final mission's completion trophy, and the gold that closes the story. Finish the last mission and the credits roll; afterwards the game returns you to free roam in Leonida with the 100% completion checklist unlocked, so nothing story-gated is left behind. There is no mission replay, so if you want to re-experience a mission, keep a manual save from before it.
steps: Play the final mission to its end.
Watch for the trophy as the mission completes.
After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to start cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is one of the named story missions, and this trophy pops when you complete it. It is unmissable — the mission is on the critical path. Just follow the mission's objectives; no special condition is attached.
steps: Reach the Breakfast Run mission in the story.
Complete each objective as marked.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a named story mission; completing it unlocks this trophy. Expect a heavy combat and driving sequence, so stock up on armour and ammo before you start, and use cover rather than rushing. The trophy is unmissable.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Stock armour and ammo before starting.
Complete the heist's objectives.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a named story mission; finish it and this trophy unlocks. It is on the critical path, so it cannot be missed. Play it at whatever pace suits you — the trophy only asks for completion.
steps: Reach the Child's Play mission.
Complete its objectives.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a named story mission; completing it unlocks this trophy. Unmissable, on the critical path. The mission's name is the clue to its tone — expect a loud one.
steps: Reach the Headliners mission.
Complete its objectives.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a named story mission; finish it for this trophy. Unmissable. The airport setting is worth remembering: the free-roam VCIA trophy (Catch Me If You Can) uses the same location later, so learn the runways and exits while you are here.
steps: Reach the VCIA Takedown mission.
Complete its objectives.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a named story mission; completing it unlocks this trophy. Unmissable and on the critical path. Heavy combat is likely, so go in with full armour and a stocked weapon wheel.
steps: Reach the Operation Savage Glory mission.
Stock up on armour and ammo first.
Complete the mission's objectives.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold for 100% completion, and the hardest trophy in the set by every published guide's account. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is more forgiving than it sounds — closer to 60% true completion: you need 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 card sets and 70 of 80 challenges, but every robbery, bank vault, gang operation, drone race, shooting range and underwater discovery is required. Budget around 100 hours for this stage alone.
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist.
Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work through the categories.
Clear the all-or-nothing categories first: robberies, vaults, gang operations, drone races, shooting ranges.
Mop up the partial categories — stunts, scans, studies, cards, challenges — to 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts cover stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps; there are 397 in the game, and 100% completion needs 300 of them, so this trophy lands on the way to the gold. Stunt jumps are the easiest to grind: fast car, long runway, ramp. Use the in-game progress tracker to see which types you still need.
steps: Find stunt jumps and ramps around Leonida.
Use fast cars for jumps and planes for flights under bridges.
Track progress under Progress > Stats.
Reach 250 stunts; keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are nine activity types in the game — the set includes things like fishing, racing, shooting range, arcade games, bowling and drone racing. You only need one attempt at each, not a win, so work through the list early and tick types off as you find them. The trophy pops the moment the ninth type is tried.
steps: Open the activities list in the pause menu or map.
Try one of each of the nine activity types.
The trophy pops on the ninth type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The ranges test speed and accuracy across weapon types; gold needs clean runs, so learn each challenge's target pattern before pushing for time, and use the weapon the challenge hands you rather than fighting it. All 42 are also required for 100% completion, so there is no skipping a hard one — practice the awkward ones until the pattern clicks.
steps: Visit a shooting range and open its challenge list.
Learn each challenge's targets, then run for gold.
Work through all 42 challenges.
Gold in the last one pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 in total. Each race is a checkpoint course flown by drone; learn the course on a first run, then race it clean for the win. All 14 wins are also required for 100% completion. If a course keeps beating you, slow down for the tight gates and make the time back on the straights.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race locations on the map.
Race each course once to learn it, then again for the win.
Win at all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts — street, off-road, water or air — as long as each win is at a different race. Mix types to keep it fresh, and use the best vehicle for the race's class rather than a favourite. Twenty distinct wins is the target; repeat wins at the same race do not add to it.
steps: Open the race list and pick a race you have not won.
Win it with a vehicle suited to its class.
Repeat at 19 more distinct races.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is a named rival for this one-off fishing challenge, so take it when it is offered and do not leave it sitting — with no mission replay in the game, a one-off challenge is safest done the first time it appears. Fishing itself is a timing game: wait for the bite, hook, then keep the line tension in the safe zone while reeling.
steps: Take Cal's fishing challenge when it is offered.
Wait for the bite, hook, and manage line tension while reeling.
Beat Cal's catch to win the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet — arcades and bars around Leonida host them — pick any game and play it through to its end. One full completion is all it takes; score does not matter.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in an arcade or bar.
Start any arcade game.
Play it through to completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's quest line runs through several missions; the trophy pops on the last one. Take Andy's missions as they appear — character quest lines are offered for a while and then move on, so do not leave them for the post-story cleanup if you can help it.
steps: Take Andy's missions as they appear.
Work through the strand to its final mission.
Complete the final mission for Andy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as the other character strands: follow Kenton's missions as they appear and finish the last one. The title hints at a boat, so expect water in the finale.
steps: Take Kenton's missions as they appear.
Work through the strand to its final mission.
Complete the final mission for Kenton.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand as it appears and finish its last mission. Character strands are best done when offered rather than saved for later.
steps: Take Billy's missions as they appear.
Work through the strand to its final mission.
Complete the final mission for Billy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear as question marks and side contacts around the map; a strand is a short chain, and you need eight chains finished, not eight single missions. Not every side questline counts, so work through the ones the game marks as stranger strands and keep count in the progress tracker. They can be done after the story.
steps: Look for stranger markers around Leonida.
Complete a full strand, not just its first mission.
Finish 8 strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand as it appears and finish the last mission. The name suggests supply runs, so expect driving and delivery work along the way.
steps: Take Randy's missions as they appear.
Work through the strand to its final mission.
Complete the final mission for Randy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand as it appears and finish the last mission — the trophy pops on completion.
steps: Take Tyrone's missions as they appear.
Work through the strand to its final mission.
Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. This is the one trophy the published guides flag as potentially missable: the first meditation is missable in Chapter 1, at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept the invitation. Do that meditation before leaving Chapter 1. After that, work through the remaining 17 spots in free roam, using the map markers and the progress tracker.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning.
Follow her to the balcony and complete the meditation — do not leave Chapter 1 without it.
Meditate at the remaining spots across Leonida.
Keep a manual save before the Chapter 1 meditation as insurance.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests revolve around wildlife; this one asks for a single unique animal, so take the hunt when Bret offers it and follow the tracking clues rather than wandering. A unique animal is a one-off, so go prepared — scoped weapon, quiet approach — and keep a manual save before the hunt in case the shot goes wrong.
steps: Take Bret's hunt when it is offered.
Follow the tracking clues to the unique animal.
Approach quietly and take the shot.
Keep a manual save before the hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets hidden around Leonida; this trophy needs any 3 complete, while 100% completion needs 15 of them. Cards are tucked into interiors, shops and out-of-the-way spots — check shelves, counters and back rooms as you explore, and use the progress tracker to see which sets are close to complete.
steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore interiors and shops.
Watch the progress tracker for nearly complete sets.
Complete any 3 sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game scanning app: point it at a location and log it. A hundred distinct locations is the target, so make scanning a habit — every new place you visit, scan it. The same habit feeds the vehicle scanning the 100% checklist wants (200 of 277 vehicles).
steps: Open the WAiNK app when you reach a new location.
Scan and log the location.
Repeat at 100 distinct locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's rotating objective list — stunt, combat, driving and exploration goals tracked under Progress. Fifty completions is the trophy; 100% completion wants 70 of 80, so this trophy lands on the way. Pick the easy ones first and let the harder ones come as your skills and kit improve.
steps: Open the challenges list under Progress.
Complete challenges across types.
Reach 50 completions.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need your partner beside you, so start this while the two of you are together in free roam. Build a 4-star wanted level — the usual way is a loud crime spree — then break line of sight, use alleys, water and off-road routes, and stay hidden until the stars clear. Losing the level with your partner still with you is what pops it.
steps: Start with your partner beside you in free roam.
Build a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The trick is the 'without losing' part: you must keep a wanted level across all three robberies, so chain them fast — rob, move to the next shop, rob again — and keep your partner with you. Plan a route with three close shops before you start, and keep a getaway vehicle nearby.
steps: Plan a route with three close shops.
Start with your partner beside you.
Rob the three shops back-to-back, keeping your wanted level throughout.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. 'Discover' means finding a vehicle type for the first time — driving past or scanning it — so variety is what counts, not mileage. Cruise different districts, check car parks, docks and airfields, and use the WAiNK app to log new finds. The 100% checklist separately wants 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, so keep scanning as you go.
steps: Explore different districts and vehicle spots.
Log each new vehicle type with the WAiNK app.
Reach 100 distinct vehicles discovered.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-time aiming mode: trigger it when a group of enemies is in view, then work through them quickly while time is slowed. Five takedowns inside one activation is the target — pick a busy fight, wait for enemies to cluster, then activate and aim for the head. If you run out of targets, let the mode end and try the next fight.
steps: Find a fight with five or more enemies close together.
Wait for them to cluster, then trigger Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before the mode ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Head to Vice City International Airport, get a plane — or anything that flies — onto a runway and take off without filing a flight plan, so to speak. Expect a wanted level the moment you do it, so take off fast and climb away from the airport. Any aircraft works; the trophy is about the departure, not the destination.
steps: Go to VCIA and get to an aircraft.
Get onto a runway and take off.
Climb away and lose any wanted level.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the game's tanks, and this trophy is about dealing with them — surviving their attention and turning the encounter around. Tanks show up at high wanted levels and in military areas, so go in with heavy weapons, use cover and height, and keep moving so the cannon cannot settle on you.
steps: Reach a high wanted level or a military area where Rhinos appear.
Engage with heavy weapons and cover.
Survive the encounter with the Rhino.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This is a stealth job: case the store first, learn the camera and guard pattern, go in quiet, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. Silenced weapons and patience beat speed here — if you are spotted, leave and try again later rather than fighting through it.
steps: Case the jewelry store: cameras, guards, exits.
Enter quiet and avoid detection.
Take the goods and leave unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; there are 8 vaults in the game, and 100% completion needs all 8, so this trophy is a milestone on the way. Plan each vault: entry, crack, grab, and a getaway route, and escape cleanly — the trophy counts only vaults you rob and escape from.
steps: Open bank jobs through the optional Chapter 4 mission.
Rob a bank vault.
Escape cleanly; repeat at 5 vaults (all 8 for 100%).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida; watch for one, block it or force it to stop, crack it open and grab the cash, then lose the wanted level that follows. A sticky bomb or a well-placed ram gets the doors open — just be ready to move the moment the cash is out.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Force it to stop and crack it open.
Grab the cash and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The map tracks 52 areas; the trophy pops when every one is visited. Drive the highways, take the back roads, and check the map for greyed-out regions — the last few are usually small islands, docks or mountain corners. Exploring as you do other trophies covers most of it; save a dedicated sweep for the end.
steps: Explore naturally as you play the story and side content.
Check the map for unvisited areas.
Sweep the remaining areas — islands, docks, mountain corners.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs with illegal operations around Leonida; you need one robbery from each gang's operation, not all of them. Scout an operation, hit it, and move to the next gang's turf. The operations are marked once discovered, so work through the list gang by gang.
steps: Discover illegal operations around Leonida.
Rob one operation for a gang.
Repeat for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view of the water, and order a cocktail. Sit, drink, enjoy the view — the trophy pops once the drink is served and the moment registers. It is a breather trophy; do it between harder jobs.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a bar with a view of the water.
Order and enjoy a cocktail.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Pick a vehicle showroom, get into a car inside, and drive straight through the glass and out onto the street — the classic GTA exit. Expect a wanted level and a bill for the damage, so use a car you do not mind losing.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom and get into a car.
Drive out through the showroom front.
Escape the wanted level that follows.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, rent a lane and bowl a full game — follow through on every throw. Score does not matter; finishing the game is what counts.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Rent a lane and start a game.
Bowl through to the end of the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is tied to your partnership — the exact trigger is still being confirmed by players, and the published guides list the method as unconfirmed. The working read is that it comes from a shared, public-facing moment with your partner — a stunt, a photo or a crowd-pleasing act done together. Try the big shared moments with your partner and watch for the pop; check the cited guides for the latest confirmed method before grinding it.
steps: Play with your partner and try the big shared moments together.
Check the cited guides for the latest confirmed method.
Repeat the shared moment until it pops.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This trophy tracks choices you make across the game — the published guides note a count that builds toward 500. Choices come up in missions, conversations and side moments, so play naturally and pick deliberately rather than rushing past prompts. The exact counting is still being pinned down by players, so treat the number as a guide and keep making choices as they come.
steps: Play through missions and side content.
Make the choices the game offers instead of skipping them.
Keep choosing as prompts appear until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This trophy is about succeeding on a second attempt — the method is still being confirmed by players, and the published guides list it as unconfirmed. The working read is that it pops when you fail something and then succeed at the same thing on the next try. If you are chasing it deliberately, pick a low-stakes challenge, fail it once on purpose, then clear it on the second attempt.
steps: Pick a low-stakes challenge you can retry.
Fail it once, then clear it on the second attempt.
Check the cited guides for the latest confirmed method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This is the game's strange-encounter trophy, and its exact trigger is still unconfirmed — the published guides list the method as not yet pinned down. It is the sort of trophy that pops when you stumble on something weird in the world: an odd event, a strange place, a moment that does not fit. Explore the odd corners of Leonida, follow strange markers, and check the cited guides as players confirm the trigger.
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners and strange markers.
Follow up anything unusual you find.
Check the cited guides for the confirmed trigger as players pin it down.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A melee drive-by means striking someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar rather than a gun. Line up a target on foot, build speed, and swing as you pass. It takes timing; practice the pass at low speed first, then commit at full speed.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Find a target on foot with a clear run-up.
Swing the melee weapon as you drive past.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money from robberies; your contacts launder them for clean cash, and the trophy counts the total laundered. Keep robbing, keep laundering, and the $250,000 total builds up over the game. It is cumulative, so there is no rush — it will come as you work the robbery trophies.
steps: Rob to earn Marked Bills.
Launder them through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every dollar you spend in shops counts — clothes, weapons, ammo, food, car mods — and the total is cumulative across the whole game. You will spend a lot naturally on gear for the harder trophies; if you are close at the end, top it up with weapon mods or a car upgrade.
steps: Spend in shops as you play — gear, ammo, clothes, mods.
Watch the cumulative total in your stats.
Top up with a big purchase if you finish just short.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garage properties to buy around Leonida. They cost serious money, so buy them as your funds allow — robbery income and laundered cash help — and keep an eye on the property list so you know which ones remain. Owning them also gives you storage for the vehicles the other trophies ask you to keep.
steps: Earn money through missions and robberies.
Buy garage properties as they become affordable.
Purchase all 8.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles you find; open it, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it. Ten registrations is the target — use a mix of cars, bikes and anything else the app accepts, and register new finds as you discover them.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register a vehicle you have found.
Register 10 vehicles in total.
